snippet.title: Puyo Puyo Tetris 2S – Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Puyo Puyo Tetris 2S has officially dropped EXCLUSIVELY on the Nintendo Switch 2!

THE ULTIMATE PUZZLE MATCH – NOW ENHANCED! AVAILABLE NOW!

SEGA Get ready to Hard Drop onto all the exciting puzzle action in Puyo Puyo Tetris 2S! Experience all new features and content including: GameShare support to play with friends using a single copy of the game, Joy-Con2 mouse control support, and camera functionality that lets you put yourself in the game alongside the brand-new "Puyo Tetris Doubles” mode where players compete in 2v2 battles with pairs using the same board to pull off devastating combos! Players can also enjoy a multi-dimensional story in the extensive Adventure mode, or compete with friends and family in a bounty of competitive local and online modes featuring support for up to 4 players and a packed roster of 40 playable characters, Including Sonic the Hedgehog, each with their own unique stats and abilities!

For more information, including where to pre-order, please visit the official website: https://www.sega.com/puyo-puyo/puyo-puyo-tetris-2s
